entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-10
entry.content:

Closed

  • Change in DefineConstants should report rude edit and restart #49545
  • dotnet watch crashes with "The WebSocket is in an invalid state ('Aborted') for this operation. Vallid states are: 'Open, CloseReceived'" #47685
  • 'dotnet test' for MTP: Handle session events correctly #50610
  • Determine WASM Hot Reload capabilities without hard-coded defaults in `dotnet watch` #38236
  • `UnknownMessageSerializer.Serialize` should throw NotSupportedException #50668
